Sarpsborg 08 and its predecessors played in [[1. divisjon]] from 2005 to 2010. In 2010, the club was promoted to the [[Tippeligaen]], the top league in [[Norway]], but finished last and was relegated back to [[1. divisjon]] in 2011. In 2012, they were promoted again and 6 years after, they qualified for their first [[UEFA Europa League|Europa League]] group stage. They play their home games at [[Sarpsborg Stadion]]."}}
